title: Directory Browsing on the IIS 10.0 web server must be disabled.
check_content:
Open the IIS 10.0 Manager.

Click the IIS 10.0 web server name.

Double-click the "Directory Browsing" icon.

Under the “Actions” pane verify "Directory Browsing" is disabled.

If “Directory Browsing” is not disabled, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Open the IIS 10.0 Manager.

Click the IIS 10.0 web server name.

Double-click the "Directory Browsing" icon.

Under the "Actions" pane click "Disabled".

Under the "Actions" pane, click "Apply".
VulnDiscussion: Directory browsing allows the contents of a directory to be displayed upon request from a web client. If directory browsing is enabled for a directory in IIS, users could receive a web page listing the contents of the directory. If directory browsing is enabled, the risk of inadvertently disclosing sensitive content is increased.
